name: ImageBackdrop
summary: Full-bleed CSS background image (no element, so the @hyperframes/producer does NOT pillarbox it) with a slow Ken-Burns push and a fade-up lower caption. Use for showing a generated or provided image edge-to-edge with continuous motion.
bestFor: Hero / concept image scenes where a single illustration or photo should fill the frame with premium motion and a short caption.

imageSrc.description: Image path (relative to the SCF/project dir). Resolved as an asset (key ends in 'Src').

kicker.description: Small uppercase eyebrow above the title.

backgroundColor.description: Fallback background behind the image while it loads.

visualBeats.description: Optional declared beats for the pre-render visual-hold validator (ceil(duration/4)).

props.title: PAL is the factory. The assistant is the worker.
props.subtitle: The factory builds the package ahead of time; the worker reads it at PR time.
